jobs.comparison_scope: Minimum declared placement rank selected across all three completed chunks before physics. Fresh-source reconstruction retains the exact retimed-source repair and qualified placement parameters. Original source arrays, coarse knots, object model and physical gates remain unchanged. This is adaptive development, separate from frozen-policy evaluation.

diagnostic_seed.scope: Physical axial grasp redundancy of the same unchanged Can. Planar base seed follows the new grasp azimuth around original cylinder axis origin; arm seed stays fixed. Full fresh geometric admission required. Explicit bounds contain original and transported source-base extents plus0.35m/0.5rad. Facet snapping may add a small angular correction; seed is never accepted by construction.
